name: magickit
description: MagicKit - operator macros for Claude Code. Small, stack-agnostic skills that control context, scope and handoff mid-session.

plugins.name: magic
plugins.description: Operator macros: refresh (context refresh), audit (scope/status audit), session (handoff), think-deep (structured task orchestrator), think (run manager for think-deep's protocol files), prompt (few-shot prompt generator + curator). Skills that keep a long session honest about what it knows, what it already decided, and what it still owes you.

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Front-door thinking skills: smart (sharpen a vague goal into a measurable + convergent statement — the IFR builder) and ideate (generate diverse ideas, adversarially select the best). Compose magic's critic; feed think!! / run!! / gauntlet!!.
